newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel quiet, mild over-supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel quiet, mild over-supply.

text.p: European straight-run markets were quiet on Friday with supply ample and little buying interest, traders said.
After the two cargo deals in Europe this week most buying interest was satisfied. A British major was offering Egyptian straight-run and a U.S. refiner was showing some British barrels on Friday.
Prices were said to be slightly off on the over-supply and weaker crude at $101-$103 fob a tonne.
Russians were thinly talked, with premiums for good quality E-4 material steady at Thursday's $2.50-$3.00 over the three means.
